conflicts_text: Normal-difficulty strategic variety contrasts with reported high-difficulty trap meta and limited replay options; qualitative individual reviews, not consensus measurements.
notes_text: Players of the original Orcs Must Die! (Steam AppID 102600; not a sequel or Unchained) praise its immediate action/tower-defense mixture, experimenting with traps, and accessible but progressively challenging campaign. An individual Steam Community review describes strong balance on normal difficulty, but reports Nightmare pushing toward a narrow set of effective traps, weak melee weapons, audio stuttering and an alt-tab interface issue. Another Steam user review says that the campaign remains fun yet there is no original-game co-op or endless mode and limited activity after campaign completion. Aggregate Steam English user sentiment remains highly positive; this does not remove the cited minority complaints.

source_log.observation: Original game product AppID 102600 and overwhelmingly positive English aggregate verified.
Individual player review excerpt covers normal/Nightmare trap balance, melee weakness, audio stutter and alt-tab spellbook issue; review year not proven.
Search result also exposed individual helpful review saying no co-op/endless and limited post-campaign content; distinguish individual account from product listing.

unknowns_text: Individual review excerpts did not establish reliable publication years. Current reproducibility of audio/alt-tab complaints and the fraction of players affected were not independently tested.
